name: Input Buffer
description: Simulates your click a few ticks ahead. If clicking now would kill you and a slightly later click survives, the click is held back and delivered later.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the predictive buffer on or off.

max-delay-frames.name: Maximum delay (frames)
max-delay-frames.description: The most a click may be held back. 1 frame = 4 physics ticks at 60 FPS.

lookahead-ticks.name: Look-ahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How far ahead each prediction runs. 240 ticks = 1 second. Higher sees further but costs more time per click.

hold-ticks.name: Assumed hold length (ticks)
hold-ticks.description: How long the prediction assumes you hold each click before releasing.

time-budget-ms.name: Time budget per click (ms)
time-budget-ms.description: If a prediction takes longer than this, your click goes through normally so the game never stutters.

wave-release.name: Predict wave releases
wave-release.description: Also hold back wave releases that would crash.
